title: Wrong Drop-Off Fare Reviews for Wayfare Rides
content:
**Rule.** On **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)** a rider who says the driver ended a completed trip somewhere other than the destination they asked for files a wrong drop-off review for the trip's fare charge with the fare review team, at the wrong drop-off review amount; support never adjusts a wrong drop-off claim itself, and a rider whose trip ended where they asked has no wrong drop-off review to file.

The wrong drop-off review amount is fixed only after the trip's fare charge carries a fare adjustment entry for every part of it billed above the guaranteed fare.

Put the other way: while some part of the fare charge billed above the guaranteed fare has no fare adjustment entry against it, the wrong drop-off review amount is not yet fixed.

## At a glance

| Rider's account of the trip | Outcome |
|---|---|
| The driver ended the completed trip somewhere other than the destination asked for | a wrong drop-off review for the trip's fare charge, filed with the fare review team at the wrong drop-off review amount |
| The trip ended where the rider asked | no wrong drop-off review to file |

Support does not adjust the fare for a wrong drop-off claim; the claim goes to the fare review team as a review.

## Filing the review — `submit_dropoff_fare_review_f18c58a7`

**Capability.** Files a wrong drop-off fare review from the rider's own app, for one fare charge: a request to the fare review team to look at a trip whose driver ended it somewhere other than the destination asked for. One call registers one fare review request with the reason wrong drop-off location, in submitted status, against the disputed fare charge of the trip, for the amount given. It changes no charge and moves no money until the fare review team decides. The rider sees the request listed under the trip's help history.

**How it is invoked.** This is the rider's own tool: the agent unlocks `submit_dropoff_fare_review_f18c58a7` with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool`, which hands it over to the rider, and the customer themselves runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`, entering the reference numbers and the amount the agent reads out to them.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `trip_id` | the trip reference number of the trip under review, as read out by the agent from the trip lookup | identifier |
| `original_charge_id` | the charge reference number of the fare charge disputed, as read out by the agent from the trip charge lookup | identifier |
| `requested_amount` | the review amount entered on the request | USD, a positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** A receipt with `fare_review_id` (reference number of the new fare review request), `trip_id` (the trip under review), `trip_charge_id` (the disputed fare charge), `review_reason` (always `wrong_dropoff_location`), `requested_amount` (USD, 2 decimal places) and `review_status`. A `review_status` of "submitted" means the request is registered.
